help:
Hi! I'm an AI assistant. Just send me a message and I'll do my best to help. I can search the web and read web pages when needed.

Commands:
/help - show this message
/reset - forget this conversation (and delete its sandbox files) and start fresh
/compact - summarise older messages to free up memory
reset_done: Done. This conversation has been cleared.
compact_done: Done. Older messages have been summarised.
compact_nothing: The conversation is still short; there is nothing to compact yet.
busy: I'm still working on your previous messages. Please wait a moment and try again.
rate_limited: You're sending messages too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_generic: Sorry, something went wrong while processing your message. Please try again.
empty_response: Sorry, I couldn't come up with a reply. Could you rephrase your message?
unsupported_attachment: Sorry, I can't read attachments yet. Please send your message as text.
not_allowed: Sorry, you are not allowed to use this bot.
